svg.title: Three tries at a triangle
svg.desc: An animation, seen from above, of three tries at a triangle, each three sides of 20 cm with a different turn. With Turn 90 the robot draws three sides of a square and stops, having turned 270 degrees in total. With Turn 60, the inside angle of a triangle, it draws a wide open zig-zag, having turned only 180 degrees. With Turn 120 it draws a closed triangle and ends on its start mark facing the way it began, having turned 360 degrees. A box beside it names each side and corner and keeps a running total of the degrees turned.
svg.text: Watch the running total. The triangle
only closes when the three corners
add up to one full turn, 360 degrees.

g.text: Turn 90: three sides of a square
